paragraphs.text: Teddy is an acorn creature type for a stuffed children's toy , made from soft or furry material, which looks like a pink bear .

The teddy type is only used on the tokens created by Water Gun Balloon Game from Unhinged (a giant grumpy version) and Dart Throw and two attractions from Unfinity . It did not receive a token card for its initial usage but did receive one for both Unsanctioned and Unfinity .
The teddy bear was named after the 26th president of the United States, Theodore Roosevelt .
